main:8.page: Dragon Slayer Ornstein and Executioner Smough
main:8.text: Encountered guarding a cathedral in central Anor Londo. Ornstein and Smough represent the last ritual challenge for the potential Chosen Undead. In fact, the Undead who tried to follow in Gwyn's footsteps to sacrifice themselves to the First Flame would have to be tested even before obtaining the Lordvessel and seeking powerful souls.
